Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Oct 14, 6:55 am, Robert Dudock wrote:
> Can a Methuselah spend their last point of pool on the Path of Tears,
> gaining the 3 pool back (for previously paid scarcity cost) and not be
> ousted?

The more general question is stated as:

Can I use the last of my pool to play a master card and remain in the
game if it gives me pool?

Yes,
If you pay for a master card, it resolves, completely.
examples: Eternals of Sirius on 4 pool, Minion Tap for 1+ when there
are a number of Villein in play equal to your pool, Path of Tears
while on 1 pool, etc.
